paragraphs.text: A desktop-style materials panel for Markdown documents created in DeepSeek Harness.
# dsh-docdesk · 资料区
An **add-only** Markdown library for DeepSeek Harness. The library starts empty: you pick the docume
nts that matter from your workspaces, place their icons on a fixed non-overlapping desktop grid, mar
quee-select several at once, and read them full-screen with browser-style tabs, GFM tables, `chart`
blocks and Mermaid diagrams rendered inline.
## Why
DSH agents write notes, plans, research and reports as `.md` files. The files stay in the workspace,
but the conversation that produced them scrolls away. 资料区 keeps the documents you choose in one pla
ce without turning your whole workspace into a list:

- Nothing is imported automatically. You decide what enters the library.
- Icons sit on a fixed desk
top grid. Two icons never share a slot; icons can be placed anywhere in the visible first screen, an

d the desktop only grows or scrolls after that first screen is full.
- A document opens as a full-sc
reen reader with tabs, not a cramped side drawer.
The plugin never moves, renames or deletes anything on disk.
## Features
- **Add files explicitly.** The **Add files** button opens a workspace picker with search and multi-

select. Documents already in the library are marked and cannot be added twice.
- **Add from a file c
ard.** A delivered Markdown file card gains an **Add to library** action; right-clicking the card op
ens a small menu with the same action. If your host does not render deliverable file cards, the pick

er is always available.
- **A fixed, non-overlapping desktop grid.** Icons snap to slot positions in
side the desktop frame. Dropping a file onto another inserts it before/after that icon; dropping bet
ween two icons inserts in the gap. Folder-over-folder drops swap positions. New icons fill the first
free slot. Before the first screen is full, any visible slot can be used; once it is full, adding a

nother icon opens a new row and the desktop scrolls.
- **Marquee selection and bulk actions.** Hold
the right mouse button and drag on empty desktop space to draw a selection box. Drag any selected ic
on to move the whole selection as a grid block. Remove the selection with Delete / Backspace, the se
lection pill in the toolbar, or the right-click menu. A multi-selection can also be put into a folde
r at once: right-click a selected item and choose a destination under **Put N items into**, or drag

the selection onto a folder icon. The files on disk are never touched.
- **Markdown charts.** Fenced
`chart` blocks are rendered into SVG bar, line, area, pie and donut charts. Data can be JSON or sim

ple `label,value` lines. Rendering is local and does not execute arbitrary code.
- **Mermaid diagram
s and GFM tables.** Fenced `mermaid` blocks render through a bundled Mermaid 12.2.0 runtime: Gantt t
imelines, `xychart-beta` charts, flowcharts, sequence/class/state/ER diagrams and more. GitHub-style
pipe tables render as real tables. Mermaid is lazy-loaded from the plugin host, not a CDN, and runs

with its strict security level.
- **Virtual folders.** Create folders and drag documents onto a fol

der icon. Folder badges show how many items are inside. Folders can be nested.

## Install
Requires **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer**.
### From the plugin market
Once the entry is merged into awesome-dsh-plugin, open **Plugins → Discover**, search for **资料区** or
**Materials**, and install it. The market installs from this repository; npm publication is optiona
*Materials**, and install it. The market installs from this repository; npm publication is optional.

In DSH Desktop you can also open **Plugins → Add** and paste the repository URL. The bundle is a sou
rce package: the root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` and `cordis.patch.yml`.
### If the install stalls on a registry warning
Warnings such as `GET https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm/... error (UND_ERR_DESTROYED)` come from
pnpm resolving **other plugins already in the profile**, not from this package: `dsh-docdesk` has n
o npm dependencies. The retries can succeed; if they do not, point the profile at a reachable regist
ncies. The retries can succeed; if they do not, point the profile at a reachable registry and retry.

## How it works
The bundle has two halves:
- **Host half** (`index.js`) scans registered workspaces, the profile's default working directory an
d live agent working directories for `.md`, `.markdown` and `.mdx` files. It exposes three read-only

JSON endpoints:
- `GET /api/dsh-docdesk/list` — candidate files for the picker
- `GET /api/dsh-docd

esk/read?path=<absolute path>` — one document's content
- `GET /api/dsh-docdesk/resolve?sessionId=…&

seq=…&index=…` — resolve a delivered file card's durable coordinates to a path
- **Client half** (`c
lient.js`) registers the **资料区** sidebar entry, the panel, the middle-edge sidebar handle and the de
livered-file action. It renders the desktop, the picker, folders and the tabbed reader.
Data and limits:
- The library (documents, display names, folders, positions, open tabs) is stored in the browser und

er `dsh-docdesk.library.v2`; it is per browser profile and is not synced between devices.
- The Mark
down files remain the source of truth. If a file is moved or deleted outside the plugin, opening it

reports the error and lets you remove the entry.
- Marquee selection, group dragging and bulk remova

l are client-side state only. Removing an entry from the library never deletes or moves a file.
- `c
hart` code blocks are parsed and drawn locally as SVG. Only the block's data is used; no arbitrary J

avaScript, external chart library or network request is involved.
- Mermaid diagrams are rendered by
the vendored Mermaid 12.2.0 bundle, served by the host route `/api/dsh-docdesk/mermaid.js` and lazy
-loaded only when a `mermaid` block is opened. The runtime uses Mermaid's strict security level; dia

gram code is not executed as JavaScript.
- GFM pipe tables and the two fenced-block formats are hand

led by the client-side Markdown renderer; no extra document preprocessing is written back to disk.
-
Both the list and read endpoints sit behind the same loopback / paired-device fence used by the bun
dled management pages and reject forwarding headers. Reads are confined to scanned roots and Markdow

n extensions; a preview is capped at 2 MB.
